selectHelp: Select an item to rename, move or duplicate it.
emptyHelp: Add a stage, standing zone or seated section to begin.
svgSourceHelp: Use an SVG with defined sections and seats to bring them in as editable objects.
backgroundHelp: Use a PNG or JPEG as a guide to draw on top of it.
csvSourceHelp: Add existing seat positions. Section codes include {{codes}}.
objectRemoved: Removed. Use Undo to restore it.

rowOutside: Draw the entire row inside the selected section.

starterHelp: Choose a starting point. Everything stays editable, and nothing is saved until you save the layout.
starterTemplates: Saved templates for this venue space
starterHelp_standingAndStands: A stage, a standing floor and two seated side stands.
starterHelp_theatre: A stage and one seating section with lettered rows and numbered seats.
starterHelp_arena: A stage, a standing floor and up to four seated stands around it.
starterGeneric: Starter layouts are generic shapes. For an exact venue, save a template or draw over a background image.
starterApplied: Added a starter layout with {{seats}} seats. Edit it, then save the layout.
starterSeatLimit: A map can have up to {{limit}} seats. Reduce the rows, seats per row or stands.
starterBadSize: Check {{size}}. It must be a whole number from 1 to {{limit}}.
csvFormatBody: One seat per line with the header section,row,seat,x,y. section is the code of a seated section on this map, row and seat are labels, x and y are positions in map units from the top-left corner. Up to 100,000 seats in total. Put a label that contains a comma inside double quotes. Nothing changes in the draft until the whole file is valid.
svgFormatBody: An SVG up to 20 MB with a viewBox and no transforms. Zones are groups with data-kind (GA or ASSIGNED), data-code and data-label, each holding a polygon. Seated zones hold rows (data-row) of seats (data-seat) with a circle each, and optional data-accessible, data-restricted-view and data-blocked set to true. Stages are groups with data-shape="STAGE". Coordinates are measured from the top-left of the viewBox. Nothing changes in the draft until the whole file is valid.
csvProblem_header: Line 1: the first line must be section,row,seat,x,y.
csvProblem_format: Line {{line}}: each line needs five values, section,row,seat,x,y.
csvProblem_duplicate: Line {{line}}, column {{column}}: this seat is already listed in its row.
csvProblem_section: Line {{line}}, column {{column}}: this is not a seated section on the map.
csvProblem_outside: Line {{line}}, column {{column}}: the seat must be inside its section.
csvProblem_limit: Line {{line}}: the file is over a limit of 5 MB, 100,000 seats, 1,000 rows or 1,000 seats per row.
zonesHelp: Choose a zone to zoom to it and see its seats.
hiddenSeatsHint: Zoom in or choose a zone to edit seats.
